name: Futago Reijou
source:
The main character works for a big company. But he is actually a spy sent from a rival company. He collects their secrets and almost breaks it down.... There are only twin sisters of the company president left.... And he is allowed to do whatever he wants to them...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305064043/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1008868]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
主角在一家大企業任職，真實身分卻是競爭對手派來的間諜。他不斷蒐集公司機密，幾乎令這家企業徹底垮臺……如今只剩下社長的一對雙胞胎女兒……而他獲准隨心所欲地處置她們……

[譯自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305064043/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1008868]Eroge Shop[/url]]
